lines.speaker: F
lines.text: Wrangler's owner let its stock slip six percent, and now it plans to put fifty million dollars back on the shelves.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: Lean looks great on the cash line until the shelves run short. This is The Planning Desk.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: Good morning, it's Thursday the nineteenth of November, and I'm Anna.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: And I'm Erik.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: Quick note, this show is made with A I. A I agents gather the news, and our voices are synthetic.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: On the desk, Kontoor Brands restocks after a rough quarter, Novo plans for scarcer water and glucose, Cambridge maps the blind spots in the A I supply chain, and Berlin agrees a power tax cut, for one year only.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: Kontoor Brands, the company behind Wrangler, says it will put fifty million dollars into inventory, Supply Chain Dive reports.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: The reason is a difficult third quarter for its supply chain, with inventory down six percent from a year earlier.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: We only have the summary of that report, so there's no detail yet on which products or which markets ran short.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: Six percent less stock can look like a win in the cash flow statement, and that's usually how this kind of story starts.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: Then the shelves run short, sales slip, and the cash you freed up goes straight back in, usually in a hurry.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: Our view, inventory targets should come from service levels, and the working capital line should be the check, not the driver.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: Run that test on your own plan. For each product family, ask what service level the current stock really supports, and whether anyone agreed to that number.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: If nobody signed off on a lower service level, then the lower stock figure is a risk that nobody has priced.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: And watch the rebuild itself. Fifty million dollars of stock arriving in one push still needs space, supplier slots and a forecast it's bought against.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: Restocking on the same forecast that let the shelves empty is how you end up with the wrong fifty million.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: Over to Denmark, where Novo is preparing for limited access to raw materials, SCM.dk reports.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: The driver is the biodiversity crisis, and water and glucose are under particular scrutiny, because both depend directly on healthy ecosystems.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: The report gives no figures and no named measures, so this is a direction of travel more than a plan we can measure.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: Still, when a Danish pharma giant treats glucose and water as inputs at risk, anyone buying fermentation or process materials should pay attention.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: Our take, add ecosystem risk to your dual sourcing reviews, because two suppliers in two countries can still draw on the same stressed water supply.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: On the A I desk, a new report from the University of Cambridge says as much as a third of the A I supply chain gets no attention from national or international policy and regulation.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: The authors call it a zone of invisibility in the middle of global A I production. The summary we have doesn't say which tiers or components fall inside it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: Planning teams now run on A I compute and models, and that puts them on tiers nobody regulates or maps.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: Give your A I services the same sub tier supplier map you'd build for any critical component, starting with who runs the compute your planning tools depend on.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: In Germany, the coalition has agreed to cut the electricity tax, but the money is secured only for twenty twenty-seven.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: A permanent cut depends on finding offsetting funds in the twenty twenty-eight federal budget. The leaders also agreed a fuel price cap from the first of January, and the cabinet is due to decide on the second of December.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: That helps production costs in German plants next year, but it doesn't settle where to build, so run your footprint models for twenty twenty-eight with the cut and without it.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: On the freight desk, the Rhine at Kaub jumped to ninety-seven centimetres on Wednesday, back above the level barges need for a full channel, and German rail path charges for twenty twenty-seven were approved about eight percent higher.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: One date for the diary, FOM University of Applied Sciences hosts a live talk on the twenty-fifth of November on how Germany's defence industry can expand production, secure supply chains and find skilled staff.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: Speakers come from Rheinmetall and Fraunhofer F K I E, and if defence volumes are heading your way as a supplier, that's the capacity conversation to hear.

lines.speaker: F
lines.text: That's the desk for Thursday.

lines.speaker: M
lines.text: Back tomorrow morning with more from the desk.
